While it is true that "Bears" (the second film co-directed by Keith Scholey for Disneynature) and "Aliens of the Deep" were filmed in different locations, the claim incorrectly identifies the co-director. Keith Scholey co-directed "African Cats" and "Bears" with Alastair Fothergill, not with a person named Nicholas.
